body.x: Hisense(www.hisense-usa.com) announced VIDAA at 'CES 2014', the biggest IT∙appliances show that is being held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

The Hisense VIDAA TV features four basic function keys, allowing for a quick and seamless switch between live TV and Internet video. The benefit of VIDAA is easy-to-use that is a major selling point in the U.S. market. Its TV has been widely accepted by consumers across China with sales.
At CES, Hisense launches its cost-competitive laser TV with plans to make the product available soon worldwide.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
